node: Indium phosphide substrates and wafers for AI optical interconnects
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the InP substrate and wafer chokepoint for AI optical interconnects. The strongest direct underfollowed candidate is AXT because it makes InP substrates and appears directly exposed to China export-permit timing. The component lane includes Lumentum and Coherent as larger, more visible InP optical-device and laser beneficiaries/customers of substrate supply. MACOM is included as an adjacent underfollowed hypothesis because it has InP laser and wafer-scale InP capability, but its exact substrate-supply sensitivity needs verification.
